metadata.description: Structure-only template for a subset of MeSH descriptors: a broader descriptor with narrower ones beneath it. Put the descriptor name in the title and its unique identifier in metadata.mesh_ui (the DescriptorUI of the MeSH XML), and keep the hierarchy with parent_code. No MeSH terms are included.
